<tool_call>

def parse_track(ascii_lines, row_idx):
    row = ascii_lines[row_idx]
    blocks = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(row):
        c = row[i]
        if c not in 'cRNG':
            block_color = c
            j = i
            while j < len(row) and row[j] == block_color:
                j += 1
            blocks.append((block_color, i, j-i))
            i = j
        else:
            i += 1
    return blocks

# Click bottom green shifter to probe its effect

def parse_track(ascii_lines, row_idx):
    row = ascii_lines[row_idx]
    blocks = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(row):
        c = row[i]
        if c not in 'cRNG':
            block_color = c
            j = i
            while j < len(row) and row[j] == block_color:
                j += 1
            blocks.append((block_color, i, j-i))
            i = j
        else:
            i += 1
    return blocks
